metadata.purpose: Validate ScenePattern create/edit/save/load round-trip inside managed Maya 2024.
acceptance: Reuse the managed Maya 2024 session when healthy or launch one automatically.
Force a new unsaved scene before validation and never save or quit Maya.
Run aimayatool.tools.scene.smoke.run_scene_pattern_smoke.
Return AIBRIDGE_UI_SMOKE_OK:SCENE_PATTERN_OPERATIONS_SMOKE_OK.
metadata.diagnosis: Managed Maya reused an existing session and returned the previous SCENE_PATTERN_SMOKE_OK marker even though current main smoke.py returns SCENE_PATTERN_OPERATIONS_SMOKE_OK. The reusable live route imported an already-cached target module without reloading it; this is runtime freshness evidence, not a product pass.
